title: feat(service-automation)!: the flow index and the activation ledger consult on (package, name) (ADR-0150 E1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9U3goQBvwMsJHNB3R7mZR7M)_
Fixes #31672

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Narrowing: (1) D3 (a), as the card declares: a package flow's bare `subflow` / `map` reference whose only holder is an environment-authored flow is refused (`outside-closure`, naming the environment); not measurable first-party. (2) D3 step 3, ruled inside ADR-0150 by the epic seat (#31527 comment 6728487836): a package flow's bare reference whose only holder is a package outside its declared dependency closure is refused (`outside-closure`, naming that package). Measured first-party: 0, including the sibling-in-one-artifact sub-case (ADR-0130 co-ownership): 0 (method under Verification). Held back, not in this PR: refusing a flow name two packages hold (a deployment sealed with a pre-phase-1 clash), pending #31677 (below).
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md (the `subflow` / `map` rows: the child resolves from the calling flow's package and its declared dependencies; an environment flow or an undeclared package's flow is refused)

epic:#31527 child E1 · `domain:server#3` · dev session `session_01ADHkmQjmHnuYAuaRd9k252`

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：流程引擎按（软件包, 名称）解析裸流程名，全部经 R 的共享解析器 `resolvePackageScopedName`：软件包内流程的子流程/映射节点先找本包，再找它声明依赖闭包里唯一的持有者；只在闭包外有持有者时拒绝并列出全部候选；启停台账按（软件包, 名称）生效。两包同名（冷启动封存的旧冲突）的拒绝暂不纳入，等 #31677 裁决，补丁已备好。
- 为什么改：专题 #31527 子卡 E1（ADR-0150 D3/D4）；让引擎不再只凭名字取第一个，为后续按包寻址的门（G1）和存储列（S3）打底。
- 风险与回滚：收窄两处（环境自建流程、未声明依赖的包的流程，被包内流程以裸名调用时拒绝），第一方实测 0 处；单持有者的裸名、两包同名的旧冲突、REST 门、触发器行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`engine.ts` 的 `execute` 闸门与 `FLOW_NAME_REFUSALS_ACTED_ON`；`plugin.ts` 的 `flowNameResolver`；`flow-activation-projection.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/flow-package-scoped-resolution.test.ts`，预期 14 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（史诗席复核三条红线之后）。

## What changes

**Step 0 — every read point that looks a flow up by bare name today** (on `origin/main` b126c130):

| # | Read point | File / symbol | Caller | This PR |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | arming a name (boot pull, `kernel:ready` bind, reload re-sync, mutation sync all end here) | `engine.ts` `registerFlow` (via `plugin.ts` `resolveFlowContenders` → `flow-precedence.ts` `resolveFlowPrecedence`, which arms the lexicographically-first package on two package holders) | no package | unchanged here: the arming gate (refuse a name two packages hold, naming both) is the held-back sealed-clash arm, below |
| 2 | running a flow by name | `engine.ts` `execute` (`this.flows.get(flowName)`) | doors, triggers (no package); `subflow` / `map` children (the calling flow's package) | gated: resolver asked for the caller's package |
| 3 | `subflow` / `map` child name | `builtin/subflow-node.ts`, `builtin/map-node.ts` → `engine.execute(flowName, childContext)` | the parent flow's package (`childContext.flowName`, stamped by `resolveRunContext`) | resolved through #2 |
| 4 | activation ledger projection | `flow-definitions.ts` `hydrateFlowActivations`, `toggleFlow`; read by `isFlowEnabled`, `describeDisabledFlow`, the §7.3 subflow guards (`subflow-guards.ts`) | — | keyed by `(package, name)` (`FlowActivationProjection`) |
| 5 | which package ships a name | `engine.ts` `packagedFlowOwner` (the loader's set, `plugin.ts` `packagedFlowReader`) | — | unchanged; it is now also the caller package of #2 and the holder #4 reads |
| 6 | context-free by-name reads | `getFlow`, `getFlowRegistration`, `toggleFlow`, `getFlowVersionHistory`, `rollbackFlow`, `unregisterFlow`, `flowCredentialHoldings` | no package | unchanged: they read the engine's one armed slot per name |
| 7 | stored references by flow name | run store (`flowName`), credential channel, dispatch keys, approvals `flow:NAME`, history by checksum | — | not here: S3 #31684 (R7–R10, R14, R20) adds the package columns |
| 8 | screen node `getFlow(flowName)` | `builtin/screen-nodes.ts` | the run's own flow | unchanged: reads the running flow's own definition |

**Step 1.** One gate, in `execute`, calls one engine seam, `flowNameRefusal`, which asks the reader the host attaches (`setFlowNameResolver`, new). The automation plugin attaches `flowNameResolver(ctx)`: `resolvePackageScopedName` from `@objectstack/objectql` over the ObjectQL registry, read at question time (the startup-registry rule). ⛔ No second resolver and no first-registered fallback: the engine reads only the resolver's `refused` answer, and acts on the reasons in `FLOW_NAME_REFUSALS_ACTED_ON` (`outside-closure`); `resolved` and `not-found` leave the existing path (a name the registry knows nothing of has one holder, the engine's own map).

- **Caller package.** `execute` reads `context.flowName`, which the engine stamps on every run context (`resolveRunContext`), so a child call carries its parent's name; the caller package is that flow's `packagedFlowOwner`, or none for a door, a trigger, or an environment-authored flow (ADR-0150 D3: an environment item resolves as a caller with no package).
- **Activation.** `flowLedgerDisabled` becomes a `FlowActivationProjection`: rows keep their `packageId`; `has(name)` answers for the package that ships the name today. A row naming no package binds to the one holder (D8's backfill reading); with no reader to say who ships the name, every row still switches it off. The two writers stay `hydrateFlowActivations` and `toggleFlow` (the existing pin in `flow-activation-ledger.test.ts` holds).
- **Dependency.** `@objectstack/objectql` moves from `devDependencies` to `dependencies` (seat-accepted file-surface amendment). No cycle: objectql's runtime workspace closure (11 packages) does not contain service-automation; `pnpm check:workspace-manifest-cycles` green.

**ADR-0150's four readings.**

- **(a)** Phase 1's one-holder tests stay green: `flow` stays in `BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES` and this PR touches nothing in objectql; the full service-automation suite (267 files, 3470 tests) and dogfood pass (Verification).
- **(b)** Bare-name behaviour is unchanged for every name with one holder, except the declared narrowing: a door, a trigger, MCP and the SDK reach `execute` with no run context, so they resolve environment-wide, and a name with one holder resolves (pinned: `reading (b)` block, plus the context-free control in the red-line-1 block).
- **(c)** No migration in this PR.
- **(d)** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`; no protocol change, so no ADR-0087 migration entry (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)` in the changeset).

## Tests

New `src/flow-package-scoped-resolution.test.ts` (14 cases) over a real `SchemaRegistry` (packages through `installPackage`, so the declared closure is the save door's) and the plugin's own `flowNameResolver`:

- own flow, closure holder, environment caller to a package holder, engine-only flow: all run;
- red line 1: D3 (a) refused naming the environment; D3 step 3 refused naming the stranger package; the door control runs the same environment flow;
- reading (b): a door runs a packaged flow by its bare name; with no resolver attached a subflow reaches an environment flow as before;
- D4: a foreign package's row does not switch the flow off, the shipping package's does; the toggle door writes and reads under the shipping package; three `FlowActivationProjection` unit cases.

No existing test changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Held back: the sealed-clash arm (red line 2 on the flow index).** Phase 1 refuses a second package holder at install, but a deployment that held the clash before phase 1 boots, sealed with a warning (`BARE_NAME_COLD_BOOT_MODE = 'warn'`), and today arms the first package's flow. Refusing that name at arming (and the `ambiguous-*` refusals in `execute`) turned exactly two phase-1 dogfood pins red on bcc5ba62 (`bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.dogfood.test.ts`: the cold-boot case and the third-package install case, both reading `armedFlowLabel('qa_shared_flow') === 'alpha flow'`) and nothing else (3650 passed). Whether to refuse is the maintainer's ruling on #31677, so per the seat this arm is isolated: the engine acts only on `outside-closure`, and this PR adds no first-pick of its own (the precedence's existing pick is untouched). The arm is a ready patch, the two `ambiguous-*` reasons, the `registerFlow` gate and its two pins (verified: applies on this head, 16/16 green), inline under Verification. If #31677 rules refuse, it lands with the dogfood pins' update.
- **D4's "all same-named flows arm" is not done here.** The engine keeps one armed slot per bare name. Arming both needs the stored run, credential and dispatch rows to carry the package (S3 #31684) so two same-named flows' runs never cross. Until then a package caller in a sealed clash whose own item is the second package's still runs the armed (first) body, as today. Open question in the report.
- **One answer moves the other way, for a stale ledger row only.** A row left by package Q for a name package P now ships no longer switches P's flow off. Reachable only when a flow name passes from one package to another; declared in the changeset. Open question in the report.
- The §7.3 subflow guards still list callers by bare reference, so a caller whose reference is now refused still counts as reaching the child (a stricter guard, unchanged from today).
- A refused child call answers `success: false` with the resolver's sentence and no `code`: no new error code is minted. The doors' `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` for an ambiguous bare address is G1's (D5).

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablations (each refusal pin; mutation through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- `FLOW_NAME_REFUSALS_ACTED_ON` emptied (`new Set([])`, head e94f303d): `Tests 2 failed | 12 passed (14)` — D3 (a) and D3 step 3 go red (the child runs: this is also the base reading, the behaviour on `main`). Restored.
- `FlowActivationProjection.has` answering `true` for any row (bcc5ba62; the file has changed since only by a type annotation): `Tests 2 failed | 14 passed (16)` — the foreign-row engine pin and unit pin go red. Restored, blob == HEAD.
- The held-back arm's `registerFlow` gate off (bcc5ba62, where it was in the tree): `Tests 1 failed | 15 passed (16)` — its two-holder pin goes red. Restored.

</details>

<details><summary>First-party narrowing measure</summary>

Every `type: 'subflow'` / `type: 'map'` node in `examples/**` and `packages/**` outside tests and the spec (`git grep` on b126c130): 5 nodes, all in `examples/app-showcase`, naming `showcase_notify_owner`, `showcase_closure_signoff`, `showcase_one_task_signoff`, `showcase_recalc_task_estimate` — flows of the same package. Refused by D3 (a): 0; by D3 step 3: 0; sibling-in-one-artifact sub-case: 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates, suite and dogfood (head e94f303d)</summary>

- **Derived gates:** `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` — 87 derived, 87 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; every recorded exit is 0 on e94f303d. The first pass (bcc5ba62) caught one real finding, fixed here: `check-tenant-audit-census` could not read the receiver of the projection's `packages.delete()`, so the receiver is now annotated `Set<string> | undefined` (no `UNTYPED_RECEIVERS` row added).
- **Package:** service-automation `vitest run` 267 files / 3470 tests passed; `tsc --noEmit` 0; eslint on the package 0.
- **Dogfood** (`turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'` then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, under the verify lock): `Test Files 440 passed | 3 skipped (443)`, `Tests 3652 passed | 41 skipped (3693)`, VERDICT command-exit 0. On bcc5ba62, with the sealed-clash arm in the tree, the same run read `2 failed | 3650 passed`, both failures in `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.dogfood.test.ts` (the held-back arm above).

</details>
